_comment: Intro dialogue for Mission Ares 1. 'speaker' is 'aria' (the base AI) or a role id from roles.json. Optional 'event' runs when the line starts: alarm_on, alarm_off, shake, lights_dim. In 'farewell', {player} = chosen crew name, {player_role} = chosen role title. Lines with speaker 'player' are said by the chosen astronaut; 'sleeper' lines are said by each sleeping crew member (one random line each).

intro.speaker: aria
intro.text: WARNING! A massive dust storm is heading toward Ares Base. Estimated arrival: 2 hours.

intro.speaker: aria
intro.text: The dust will block up to 99% of the sunlight that reaches our solar panels.

intro.speaker: engineer
intro.text: Ninety-nine percent?! Those panels power everything: the heaters, the oxygen maker, the water recycler...

intro.speaker: astrophysicist
intro.text: Martian dust storms can last for weeks. In 2018 one covered the whole planet, and NASA's Opportunity rover ran out of power.

intro.speaker: medic
intro.text: A.R.I.A., how long can our batteries keep all four of us safe?

intro.speaker: aria
intro.text: Calculating... Battery reserves support 4 crew members for 9 sols. Storm duration estimate: 35 sols.

intro.speaker: biologist
intro.text: A sol is one Martian day. 9 sols of power for a 35-sol storm... that's not enough. Not even close!

intro.speaker: engineer
intro.text: Wait, the cryo pods! Sleeping crew use almost no oxygen, food or heat.

intro.speaker: medic
intro.text: Cryosleep is safe. But someone must stay awake to run the base and watch over the pods.

intro.speaker: aria
intro.text: Confirmed. With 3 crew asleep and 1 awake, reserves last 38 sols. Enough... but only if every choice is a smart one.

intro.speaker: astrophysicist
intro.text: Then it's decided. Three of us sleep. One of us stays.

intro.speaker: aria
intro.text: Commander, the crew is waiting for your decision. Who will keep Ares Base running?

farewell.speaker: player
farewell.text: I'll stay. As the {player_role}, I can keep this base running until the storm is over.

farewell.speaker: aria
farewell.text: Starting cryosleep sequence. Sleeping crew, please enter your pods.

sleeper_lines: We trust you, {player}. Wake us up when the sky is clear!
Remember: every bit of energy counts. Good luck!
Don't forget to water my plants... and to eat!

ending.speaker: aria
ending.text: Cryosleep sequence complete. Three crew members are safe and sleeping.

ending.speaker: aria
ending.text: {player}, you are now the only one awake on Mars. Ares Base is in your hands.
